passages.title: Dialogue 1: Photography
passages.text:
Woman: Did you see the photos I posted from my weekend walk?
Man: Yes, they're amazing! The lighting in the forest was perfect. I didn't know you were so good at photography.
Woman: Thanks! I've been practicing a lot, but I still struggle with getting the focus right on moving objects, like birds.
Man: Well, you've definitely got a talent for landscapes.

passages.title: Dialogue 2: Hiking
passages.text:
Man: Are you coming hiking with us on Sunday? We're going up to the peak.
Woman: I'd love to, but my hiking boots are completely worn out, and I haven't had time to buy new ones.
Man: You could just wear your running trainers. The path is quite flat until the very end.
Woman: Actually, the weather forecast says it's going to rain, so the ground will be too muddy for trainers. I'll pass this time.

passages.title: Dialogue 3: Board Games
passages.text:
Woman: Have you played that new strategy board game yet?
Man: Yes, my brother bought it. It took us about an hour just to read the instructions!
Woman: I know, it's really complicated at first. But once you get started, it's incredibly fun.
Man: Definitely. We ended up playing until midnight. I can't wait to play it again this weekend.

passages.title: Dialogue 4: Cooking Class
passages.text:
Man: How was your first Italian cooking class yesterday?
Woman: It was great! The chef was really funny and explained everything clearly.
Man: Did you make pasta from scratch?
Woman: Yes, though mine turned out a bit too thick. Still, it tasted amazing, and I learned some useful techniques that I can easily try at home.

passages.title: Dialogue 5: Cinema
passages.text:
Woman: Do you want to see the new science-fiction film tonight?
Man: I've heard the special effects are incredible, but the story is quite weak and predictable.
Woman: Really? The reviews I read said the acting was brilliant, especially the main character.
Man: Well, I suppose we should judge for ourselves. Let's get tickets.

passages.title: Dialogue 6: Guitar Practice
passages.text:
Man: I'm thinking of giving up the guitar. I've been practicing for three months and I still can't play a whole song.
Woman: Don't be so hard on yourself! It takes time. Are you practicing every day?
Man: Well, only on weekends, really. I'm too tired after work.
Woman: That's the problem. Even fifteen minutes a day during the week would make a huge difference.
